source_note: Transcribed from full-resolution card images, 2026-11-05. Numbers read off the card face: cost top-left, life on the heart, strength bottom-right. SW Zone's setup sheet marks events as coming in 2 copies, so the eight event slots are four distinct cards x2.

cards.name: Sneeks
cards.ability: Once per turn during your Attack Phase, this unit may exchange places with a friendly 0 cost unit.

cards.name: Beast Rider
cards.ability: When this unit moves it may move up to 2 extra spaces if it moves only in one direction; moving 3 or more spaces in one direction gives it +1 strength until end of turn.

cards.name: Horde Slinger
cards.ability: You may choose this unit as an extra attacking unit during your Attack Phase.

cards.name: Horde Climber
cards.ability: When this unit moves, it may move 1 extra space and through structures.

cards.name: Horde Clinger
cards.ability: Cannot move. When a friendly unit starts its move adjacent to this unit, after that move you may place this unit adjacent to that unit.

cards.name: Blarf
cards.ability: At the start of your Attack Phase, either spend 1 magic to place a boost on this unit or add 1 damage to it. This unit has +1 strength for each boost on it, to a maximum of +5.

cards.name: Smeg
cards.ability: At the end of your turn, either spend 1 magic or discard this unit. You may choose this unit as an extra attacking unit during your Attack Phase.

cards.name: The Eater
cards.ability: At the end of your Attack Phase, if this unit did not destroy a unit this turn, either discard a friendly adjacent unit or discard this unit.

cards.name: Enrage the Horde
cards.ability: Target all friendly 0 cost units. Each target may resolve an extra attack.
cards.source: card photo, full resolution — phase icon not legible, inferred from its effect (extra attack)

cards.name: Unrelenting
cards.ability: Each time a friendly common would be destroyed, instead of destroying it, return it to your hand.

cards.name: Pile On
cards.ability: Friendly units have this ability: when this unit attacks, it has +1 strength for each other friendly unit adjacent to its target.

cards.name: Sneak
cards.ability: Target any number of friendly 0 cost units. Force each target 1 space.
